thread:
zoe: Noticed a sudden surge of 502s from embeddings in eu-west1 at 04:10. Looks like an accidental model promotion to legacy-quant during autoscale. Requesting an urgent region-only hotpatch and approval to bypass staged canary.

deploybot: Preflight: CI ✅, E2E 9/10 (one unrelated flaky), infra-checks ✅. Emergency deploy command: ```./deploy --svc=embeddings --region=eu-west1 --image=ghcr.io/redwood/embeddings@sha256:ff11ee22 --emergency```

ops-oncall: Impact: ~14% 502 rate on /v1/embeddings eu-west1 last 12m. Retries causing queueing and latency increases. No DB work.

ana: What's the exact rollback plan if this gets worse?

zoe: Rollback trigger: 502 > 3% sustained for 5m OR p50 latency +150ms vs baseline. Rollback command ready: ```kubectl rollout undo deploy/embeddings -n prod --to-revision=stable-2026-03-30```

deploybot: Emergency path requires explicit approval phrase from oncall + ops-lead. Please respond with: "approve emergency cutover".

ops-oncall: approve emergency cutover - I'm oncall and will monitor metrics and traces.

ops-lead: I approve emergency cutover for eu-west1 only. Condition: auto-rollback on triggers above. Keep eu-central fallback open.

pm: +1 from product; customer impact confirmed.

zoe: Kicking off emergency rollout now. Logs: "pull ff11ee22 -> creating new pods -> draining old pods"

deploybot: Rolling out emergency override: batch=100%, timeout=8m. Health streaming enabled.

ops-oncall: 3m: error rate down to 7%, p50 300ms.

deploybot: 6m checkpoint: readiness 94%, healthchecks OK.

ops-oncall: 9m: final: 1.6% 502s, p50 170ms. No alerts.

ops-lead: Close the emergency window and file a short RCA. Add model-promote gating to CI.

zoe: Draft release note: "region hotpatch (eu-west1): emergency swap to stable-model to mitigate 502s; tightened timeouts." Will publish to #release-notes.

deploybot: Emergency deploy complete. Closed emergency window.

ops-oncall: Monitoring for 60m; will reopen thread if regression.

zoe: Closing thread. :white_check_mark:
